text:
Arjun: Handing off OrionAI (healthtech) to CS. MRR $15k, BAA signed. Pilot target 2026-04-14. Needs private VPC, Okta SSO, and PHI-safe logging. Sales notes: likely burst on pilot (~550 reqs/min). Main risks: delayed SAML file, cert rotation timeline, peering window. cc @selena @toni

Selena: Ill own the onboarding + enablement. Who is the Okta admin and do we have SAML metadata? Also need cert owner for ingress TLS steps.

Arjun: Okta admin is ops@orionai.ai. Uploaded initial SAML metadata to account folder (internal link). Customer will manage certs and asked for step-by-step guidance.

Toni: Ill open infra tickets: SUP-9110 for SSO support and ENG-5019 for VPC peering. Eng needs CIDR ranges and preferred peering windows from the customer.

infra-bot: Created ENG-5019 and assigned to eng-infra oncall.

Selena: Action list Ill track: 1) Collect final SAML XML (owner: selena, due: 2026-03-29) 2) Cert guide + sample commands (owner: arjun, due: 2026-03-26) 3) ENG preflight + ENG-5019 (owner: toni) 4) Schedule enablement + PHI runbook (owner: selena, session: 2026-04-06) 5) Pilot surge plan (owner: ops, note: request temporary burst nodes)

Arjun: Heads up on renewal: 12mo term; usage expected to ramp late. Recommend QBR in month 8 to lock-in expansion.

Toni: Quick smoke test for CS once staging is up:

curl -X POST https://staging.redwood.internal/v1/generate \\n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <TEST_TOKEN>' \\n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \\n  -d '{"input":"PHI redaction test: Patient Carlos, MRN 9999"}'

Selena: Well run that to validate redaction hooks and logging obfuscation. Ill make a Confluence onboarding page with runbook + ticket links and post here. :thumbsup:

Arjun: Customer requested a go/no-go sync on 2026-04-09. Please surface blockers by 2026-04-01.

infra-bot: Reminder scheduled: follow-up 2026-03-30 10:00 PT.

Selena: Marking renewal-risk: medium; will include early adoption metrics in QBR agenda.

Arjun: Thanks team, happy to join cert call if helpful."
